p5_b2.ocr: The data presented in Table 1 illustrates significant trends in these areas, highlighting the importance of maintaining optimal faculty support in relation to student enrollment. p5_b3.ocr: Furthermore, Institute D has achieved a RetentionRate of 72, indicating a strong ability to maintain student enrollment over time. These ratios and rates are key indicators of institutional effectiveness. Additionally, the financial data reveals that while the allocation for educational resources was originally set at $5M for 2019, projections for the following year suggest an increase to $6M, reflecting a commitment to enhancing educational support systems.
